version.description: Which version of this format the file is written in.

presets.description: Your presets, by name. Each lists only what it changes from the defaults.

background.description: The video behind the terminal: a built-in background's name, or a path to a video file.

font.description: The typeface: the name of an installed font ("Menlo", "JetBrains Mono", or a specific face such as "Menlo Bold"), "Monaspace Neon" (bundled), or a path to a font file. Characters the font lacks come from Monaspace Neon, then the system's fonts.

font_size.description: Text size, in points. View > Bigger and Smaller change it for one window, and Default Size returns to this. 6 to 72.

exposure.description: Brightness of the background video. 0 to 2.

hue_shift.description: Rotates the background video's colors, in degrees. 0 to 360.

crt.description: The CRT effect: scanlines, curvature and glow.

hdr_text.description: Draw text brighter than SDR white on HDR displays.

ligatures.description: Draw pairs like -> and != as single symbols.

typing_animation.description: Animate output as it is typed onto the screen.

theme.description: The color theme: text, the cursor, the selection, and the colors programs use. Any of its colors can be changed in [presets.<name>.colors].

foreground.description: Text color, as "#rrggbb". Empty uses the theme's.

background.description: The background color programs paint with, and that sink reports to programs that ask whether it's light or dark. A video background shows through it. Empty uses the theme's.

cursor.description: Cursor color. Empty uses the theme's.

selection.description: Selection highlight, drawn translucently over what's behind it. Empty uses the theme's.

palette.description: The 16 colors programs choose from: black, red, green, yellow, blue, magenta, cyan, white, then their bright versions. A shorter list replaces just the first colors; the rest stay the theme's.

preset.description: The preset in use: a built-in such as "pool", or the name of one of your [presets.<name>] tables.

scrollback_lines.description: Lines of output kept above the screen, per pane. 100 to 1000000.

integration.description: Load sink's shell integration into zsh and bash: prompt marks (OSC 133) and the working directory (OSC 7), which make Cmd+Up/Down prompt jumping and new tabs in the current directory work.

option_as_meta.description: Make Option act as Meta, sending ESC before the key (for emacs and readline shortcuts) instead of typing special characters. true for both Option keys, or "left" or "right" for just one.
